annotations.title: Advance and check a Style Sheet character change

description: Requires an approved AlertForge account connection. OAuth-aware clients should start AlertForge's secure authorization flow and ask the user only to sign in and approve. Setup: https://alertforge.ai/ai-agents#agent-setup. Advances the queued character edit, performs the server-side region patch, and returns the revised full Style Sheet image when complete. Call repeatedly until completed or failed. Credits reserved for a failed patch are restored.
name: get_style_sheet_character_edit_status
title: Advance and check a Style Sheet character change
